text: As for CBD/cannabis, people do smoke or vape it at the start of an aura, while they're still awake enough to do it on purpose. There are also people who find THC and/or CBD works as a nasal spray or sublingually, and there's even a medical THC nasal spray marketed for seizure interruption in Brazil by a patients' association called ABRACE. They testified in Congress that in more than 30 tests they did with children having seizures, the nasal spray ended those seizures within 30 seconds. You can see it being used on a child in this vid: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bgVi5o_2v_w
reader: someone with a person who is having, or about to have, a seizure from MDMA or a psychedelic overdose, which is generalized, and who wants to know what can stop it now

sentences.s: As for CBD/cannabis, people do smoke or vape it at the start of an aura, while they're still awake enough to do it on purpose.

There are also people who find THC and/or CBD works as a nasal spray or sublingually, and there's even a medical THC nasal spray marketed for seizure interruption in Brazil by a patients' association called ABRACE.
sentences.payoff: the reader learns the two faster routes (nose, under the tongue) and that a THC spray is made for exactly their situation, stopping a seizure; "patients' association" tells them it's families' own product, not an approved medicine, so they weigh the next sentence's numbers that way
sentences.follows: continues the first sentence's ways of taking cannabis at an aura (smoking, vaping) with the other fast routes

sentences.s: They testified in Congress that in more than 30 tests they did with children having seizures, the nasal spray ended those seizures within 30 seconds.
sentences.payoff: the reader learns how fast it worked in the makers' own reports (under 30 seconds, in more than 30 children's seizures), the speed an active seizure needs, and where the claim was made
sentences.follows: says what the spray named in the sentence before did, and who said so

sentences.s: You can see it being used on a child in this vid: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bgVi5o_2v_w

checked.found: a non-profit association of patients and families (associação sem fins lucrativos) that the courts have let grow cannabis and supply its members since 2017; its products aren't registered as medicines with Anvisa (Canaltech; Anvisa decision 1606002, 2021)
checked.still_needed: yes: who makes it tells the reader how much weight the 30 tests carry

checked.found: "Nos mais de 30 testes que fizemos, as crianças voltaram em menos de 30 segundos" (Cassiano Teixeira, ABRACE's executive director, Câmara special committee on PL 399/2015, 19 Nov 2019)
checked.still_needed: yes: it's the number that says how often it worked

checked.found: "em menos de 30 segundos" (in under 30 seconds), the same testimony
checked.still_needed: yes: the speed is this section's payoff

checked.found: the testimony: "eficácia do spray nasal, no caso, do THC, para parar a crise"; the video's title: "Beni utilizando o Spray Nasal (THC Abrace) produzido no Brasil."
checked.still_needed: yes: it's what the spray is
